notes.title: inbento v2.50 (Nov 12th 2024) - Birthday / Cooking Fest Update
notes.notes:
Hi! Update v2.50 for inbento is available now across Windows and MacOS on Steam and we hope you'll enjoy what it offers. To celebrate we've also launched a discount just in time for the Steam Cooking Fest!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567440/inbento/


This is a maintenance update (meaning that there are no new puzzles to solve) which introduces a whole range of improvements that the community was asking for in the past. 

The big two changes are the addition of a Reduced Motion Mode, meant to help motion-sickness-prone players by simplifying transitions between levels; and the Unlock All Levels toggle to help you carry over progress from other platforms, or just skip that pesky puzzle you've been having trouble with (I'm looking at you, 11-5).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202061/01f99eb280921e03aeacfd6afb85fb38bae479b4.gif


Patch notes for inbento v2.50:

 Added a “Reduced Motion Mode” toggle in Options,
     > We’re happy to be able to bring over this often-requested feature from our other games,
     > When enabled, transition animations between main menu, photos and levels will be replaced by a fade in order not to trigger motion sickness for certain players,

 Added an “Unlock All Levels” toggle in Options,
    > This also makes the jump from our other titles!
    > When enabled, you’re free to check out any* level or photo in the game without the need to unlock it first,

 Improved game display for aspect ratios other than 16:9,
     > Now it should be easier to enjoy inbento if you’re using a 4:3 screen, or a whopping 32:9 display!

 Added a new section - Other Games - to the main menu,
 Added white fade when browsing between photos to make the interface look nicer on non-standard displays,
 Added info about the current build version to the main menu,
 Added a loading screen when returning from game to the main menu,

 Changed intro screen to white to create a better first-time user experience,
 Rearranged the items in Options to make it easier to find things,
 Reworked the VSync toggle to support On/Off instead of having multiple options,
 Increased resolution of tab icons in main menu,
 Removed the tiny scrollbar visible in credits,
 Updated in-game credits,

 Fixed level label when playing the hidden level,
 Fixed the mute button not working as intended,
 Fixed not being able to close the Clear Save popup using ESC/B buttons,
 Fixed the display resolution list not working as intended on MacOS,
 Fixed the parallax in some photos not working as intended,
 Fixed box texturing not looking as intended when camera was moving,


If you happen to have any issues with the new patch, be sure to let us know via the Community Forum or by mailing us at inbento@afterburn.games.

Additionally, if you encounter any problems with the game that prevent your progress, we've kept the old build - v2.04 - available on a "legacy" branch which you can enable by going into the game's settings:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202061/c221f6d2488ade245b5e935af964a68ebfb49cc6.png

We hope that this update will keep inbento enjoyable for years to come :)

Cheers,
Team at Afterburn

notes.title: inbento is 5 years old! v2.50 update BETA and new artwork - available now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Time flew by in a flash and somehow, it's been whole 5 years since inbento first launched back in September 2019! To celebrate we've got cool stuff to share with you:

Daily Deal - live now!
From 3rd till 17th of September you can grab inbento at a whopping -80% discount! If you haven't had the chance to try out our delicious puzzle game be sure to check it out now :) And speaking of delicious stuff...

Here's our new key artwork!
Just like last year we collaborated with a great Polish comic book artist - Tomasz Spell (https://kreskotok.blogspot.com/) - to update inbento's store artwork with some fresh colors:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202061/bfffd7301f40cb135e05624ba61c475db58da854.png

Click on the image above to grab it as a 4K wallpaper if you'd like :)

Last but not least - v2.50 update beta is live now!
We also planned to celebrate this 5th birthday by releasing a big maintenance update for inbento. Unfortunately, ongoing work on our next game - Pup Champs - didn't give us enough time to finish doing everything we wanted, which is why we decided to release the update in beta and fully wrap it up later this year.

You can try the update for yourself by going into the game's Preferences > Betas and entering the access code happybirthday to unlock the [anniversary] branch:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202061/365e1fbcbdf3abf6039c2a3a5679119797192983.png

Update v2.50 does not add any new puzzles or story artwork to the game, but it was a good opportunity to clean up some old code and introduce a bunch of features that already debuted in Golf Peaks and Railbound.

To that end we added some long-requested accessibility features like toggles for unlocking all levels, muting all audio and reducing motion sickness:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202061/01f99eb280921e03aeacfd6afb85fb38bae479b4.gif

We also cleaned up the Options menu, fixed some issues related to screen resolutions on MacOS, tweaked input when changing story illustrations & more! We'll do a deeper dive into these changes once the update leaves beta; but for now we'd be glad if you helped us test this patch and left your feedback.

However, the main reason for this update was unifying the mobile and standalone (read: all other platforms) versions of inbento that used to live on two separate branches (because of how their user interfaces were constructed) into one, allowing us to make future work on the game easier. We don't have any content (read: new puzzles) planned for inbento at this moment, but if we ever wanted to add them, the work we put in over the past month will make it a bit easier :)

That's it for today - and see you soon!

Cheers,
Luke from Afterburn

PS. Check out our new game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2848800/Pup_Champs/

notes.title: Railbound - Birthday Update launches Sep 6th!
notes.notes:
Hi!

Railbound's first birthday is just around the corner and we decided to celebrate it with a brand-new free update to the game!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42290292/1b0bed3cad611a7eb9d9b8f2168354dae2b98d59.png

On September 6th 2023 (next week!) get ready to solve over 40 new puzzles, try out the new mechanic - Two Locomotives - which remixes the default gameplay in fun new ways, and explore our most detailed Worlds yet! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQLGxM6Q6nY

Thanks for your support and see you next week :)

- Luke
